{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.
","path":"outputs/rca.md"}

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.
","path":"outputs/rca.md"}

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:
   - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (young placeholders, before the 30-min zombie threshold);
   - a placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide is the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read the new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch (lands on the new head) → stamp the new head → re-arm → marker comment.

{"content":"# gh-852 — Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate on every queued dispatch

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a PR head carries placeholder check-runs — pending/in_progress check-runs whose `html_url` has no numeric workflow-run id, minted by GitHub ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job, orphaned when the real run never stamps their context — branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so the placeholders pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` even though every real check-run is green. Same-sha re-dispatch can NEVER cure it (a queued re-dispatch mints fresh placeholders); only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation does. Live fa #1457 (2026-10-11): heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors pinned BLOCKED, 5 operator resets per day.

**Root cause**: `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` already detects the *shape* (link-less pending stamps) but only as `stale-no-runner` zombies past the 30-minute staleness threshold — and, more importantly, every gh-842 zombie remedy in `js/smAgent.js` (green-cover VOID fall-through, latch-skip VOID fall-through, sweep re-dispatch) is a **same-sha** re-dispatch. For placeholder-shaped ghosts a same-sha re-dispatch is mechanically wrong: if the re-dispatch queues again, GitHub mints new placeholders on the same sha and the gate stays BLOCKED. The engine has no placeholder-specific detection (3-minute grace, not 30-minute staleness), no fresh-sha remedy (`silentUpdateBranch`), no pool-free probe, and no per-PR retry cap.

**Impact**: Every queued dispatch on a repo whose placeholder-prone workflow (bridge-free stamps, saturated self-hosted pool) can pin approved green PRs BLOCKED indefinitely; the only unblock is an operator reset, which the next queued dispatch re-breaks.

**Fix approach**:
1. Extend `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive — AC3: existing zombie/cancel rules untouched) with placeholder detection (`placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace; a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp, so age is the only safe proof) and per-PR windowed reset bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf` — cap default 3 per 2h window; per-PR, NOT per-head, since every reset mints a new head).
2. Wire `js/smAgent.js`:

## gh-852: Check-run placeholders pin the merge gate — engine auto-reset on detection + pool-free probe

### Root Cause
- Placeholder check-runs (pending, `html_url` with no numeric run id — minted ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job) pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED`: branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so they shadow every green real check (live fa #1457: heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors, 5 operator resets/day).
- The engine's only remedy was the gh-842 same-sha re-dispatch — mechanically wrong here: a queued re-dispatch mints FRESH placeholders on the same sha. Only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation cures the gate.

### Fix
- `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive, AC3-safe): `placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace (a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp; only age proves no runner is coming); `hasPlaceholderZombies()` — the run-id-less zombie shape; per-PR windowed reset cap bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf`, default 3 per 2h — per PR, not per head: every reset mints a new head).
- `js/smAgent.js`:
  - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (detected at the 3-min grace, not the 30-min zombie staleness);
  - placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide, the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch → stamp the new head → re-arm `ai_validating` → marker comment. Run-id zombies keep the legacy same-sha dispatch (AC3).

### Test Coverage
- `js/unit-tests/test_checkRunZombies.js` — gh-852 suites: detection (incl. the d29efb16 replay: placeholder caught at the 3-min grace while `classify()` still reads it live), fail-safe young/unparseable stamps, knob tuning, cap bookkeeping round-trip.
- `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` — 4 new tests: AC1 placeholder-pinned green PR → exactly one silent-update refresh + one dispatch + arm + `placeholder reset 1/3` marker; AC2 busy pool → deferred, zero churn; AC2 cap reached → one park note, no resets; AC3 run-id zombie → legacy dispatch, no refresh.
- Full suite: `run_all.json` — **2524 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- The pool probe is deliberately conservative (any ACTIVE run repo-wide blocks a reset) — the ticket's macos/ubuntu-arm labels ride job objects, not the run list; it also subsumes the gh-798 in-flight-leg guard.
- On a failed validation dispatch after the refresh, the fresh sha stands and the next tick validates it normally (self-healing; the attempt is not cap-counted, matching the gh-821 zombie contract).
- New knobs: `checkRunPlaceholderMinutes` (default 3), `placeholderResetCap` (default 3), `placeholderResetWindowMs` (default 2h).

### Root Cause
- Placeholder check-runs (pending, `html_url` with no numeric run id — minted ~20s after a dispatch that queued without materializing a job) pin `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED`: branch protection takes the LATEST check-run per (context, head), so they shadow every green real check (live fa #1457: heads d29efb16 + 3 predecessors, 5 operator resets/day).
- The engine's only remedy was the gh-842 same-sha re-dispatch — mechanically wrong here: a queued re-dispatch mints FRESH placeholders on the same sha. Only a fresh sha + an immediate-start validation cures the gate.

### Fix
- `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` (additive, AC3-safe): `placeholders()` — link-less pending stamps older than a 3-min grace (a fresh stamp may be a live dispatch's bridge stamp; only age proves no runner is coming); `hasPlaceholderZombies()` — the run-id-less zombie shape; per-PR windowed reset cap bookkeeping (`placeholderMarks`/`placeholderMarkerLine`/`placeholderRetryAllowed`/`placeholderCapOf`/`placeholderWindowMsOf`, default 3 per 2h — per PR, not per head: every reset mints a new head).
- `js/smAgent.js`:
  - green-cover and latch-skip guards: placeholder check-runs VOID the skip too (detected at the 3-min grace, not the 30-min zombie staleness);
  - placeholder gate at the validate_pr dispatch point: cap check (AC2) → repo pool-free probe via `github_list_workflow_runs` — no ACTIVE run repo-wide, the conservative macos/ubuntu-arm proxy; probe failure fails CLOSED (AC2) → `silentUpdateBranch` fresh-sha refresh → re-read new head → `dispatchCiWorkflow` on the branch → stamp the new head → re-arm `ai_validating` → marker comment. Run-id zombies keep the legacy same-sha dispatch (AC3).

### Test Coverage
- `js/unit-tests/test_checkRunZombies.js` — gh-852 suites: detection (incl. the d29efb16 replay: placeholder caught at the 3-min grace while `classify()` still reads it live), fail-safe young/unparseable stamps, knob tuning, cap bookkeeping round-trip.
- `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` — 4 new tests: AC1 placeholder-pinned green PR → exactly one silent-update refresh + one dispatch + arm + `placeholder reset 1/3` marker; AC2 busy pool → deferred, zero churn; AC2 cap reached → one park note, no resets; AC3 run-id zombie → legacy dispatch, no refresh.
- Full suite: `run_all.json` — **2524 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes
- The pool probe is deliberately conservative (any ACTIVE run repo-wide blocks a reset) — the ticket's macos/ubuntu-arm labels ride job objects, not the run list; it also subsumes the gh-798 in-flight-leg guard.
- On a failed validation dispatch after the refresh, the fresh sha stands and the next tick validates it normally (self-healing; the attempt is not cap-counted, matching the gh-821 zombie contract).
